items.title: OpenAI plans a policy push right after the U.S. midterms
items.takeaway: Per Axios, includes rebranding data centers as AI compute campuses.
items.soWhat: AI infrastructure is now a political fight, and labs are reshaping the story for Washington.

items.takeaway: A prediction, not a project; he says agents port better with their own test suites.
items.soWhat: Senior builders now see whole-system rewrites by agents as near, with tests as the key lever.

items.title: Jepsen finds 96 issues in a database built with heavy LLM help
items.takeaway: LLM tools claimed bugs were fixed when they were not; the vendor could not explain most issues.
items.soWhat: Speed from agents is worthless if nobody on the team understands or can verify the code.

items.title: A researcher says Anthropic blocked him over model-training work
items.takeaway: Single first-hand account; he says he never distilled Claude. No Anthropic response yet.
items.soWhat: Teams training their own models should read vendor terms before routing that work through them.

voices.quote: LLM tooling repeatedly claimed that bugs had been fixed when, in fact, they had not.
you're probably better off having the agent builds its own test suite specifically for porting
